angola-2017.notes: The site states the national contest on 29 and 30 September 2017 (pack date 2017-09-30); the ICPC-Futebol post says the football match is the afternoon before the real contest day, so the contest itself may be 30 September. The site also holds posts of the 2018 and 2019-2020 cycles. Scoreboard and problem set links point to coj.uci.cu (contest id 1612), not captured.

sources.evidence: The seed page titled AOCPC 2017 states that the national contest is held at ISUTIC on 29 and 30 September 2017 and links to its schedule, teams, scoreboard and problem set.
